top_issues: Grey microcopy 'send up to 175.00' / 'receive up to 0.50' is the only place the credit direction appears and is ~12px; Rosa cannot read it glasses-off.
'All activity' is a low-contrast text link at the fold edge, easy to miss one-handed.
fixes: Raise all directional capacity labels to >=14px and prefix with an arrow glyph so meaning is not size/colour dependent.
Promote 'All activity' to a bordered button with a chevron.

top_issues: Pay/Receive/Swap sit mid-screen; on a tall phone the thumb reaches nav, not the primary action.
'Show 2 empty' tab label is cryptic and colour-neutral grey, looks disabled.
fixes: Add a sticky bottom action bar with the last-used primary CTA.
Rename 'Show 2 empty' to 'Show empty balances' with an eye icon.

top_issues: Fee '0.000050 USDC' renders in tiny grey tabular text; the precision reads as noise, not cost.
Two routes show identical 'You send 25.00' so the only differentiator (fee) is the smallest text on the card.
fixes: Show fee as 'under 0.01 USDC' by default with exact value behind a tap.
Bold the cheaper route's fee and add a 'cheapest' tag.

top_issues: Recipient identity is the long hex address dominating the 'To' card; the human name H2 is smaller.
'Up to 175.00 instantly' is the spendable hint but is violet, the same colour reserved for hub promises elsewhere.
fixes: Collapse the address to a truncated chip with a copy button; enlarge the resolved name.
Render spendable-now hints in white, not violet, to keep violet strictly = promise.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:24:03 in 9 s' mixes an absolute clock with a relative duration in one line; the 'in 9 s' reads like a countdown still running.
Four equal-weight buttons (Copy/Download/Print/Done) dilute the terminal action.
fixes: Split into 'Settled 05:24:03' and a separate 'confirmed in 9 s' badge.
Demote Copy/Download/Print to a secondary row; keep 'Done' as the single filled CTA.

top_issues: Proof hash is truncated to '0x00109fe5…6bec' with no tap-to-expand, so Elena cannot verify on screen.
Modal covers the home total balance, so the user loses the post-payment balance context.
fixes: Make the proof row tappable to reveal/copy the full hash.
Show the new running total in the sheet header.

top_issues: Three long explanatory paragraphs (share, entity id, capacity) turn a payment screen into a manual; Priya at a counter cannot scan it.
'YOUR ENTITY ID' hex block has no copy affordance visible.
fixes: Move all prose behind an 'i' disclosure; keep only the QR, amount and a single 'Tap to copy' row.
Add a copy icon button on the entity id card.

top_issues: QR is huge but the '0.50 capacity via H1' inbound-room warning is tiny grey text beside the amount, so a counter payment can silently fail.
No 'waiting for payment' live state visible for Jamal's many small arrivals.
fixes: Surface inbound capacity as a coloured status pill ('room for $0.50') above the QR.
Add a pulsing 'listening…' indicator and an inline row when a payment lands.

top_issues: Book depth bars are decorative gradient; size column is the real data but same weight, so Wei must read numbers not bars.
'Tap a level to fill the ticket' is the only instruction and sits at the very bottom, below fold.
fixes: Scale the depth bar to the size value and label the max.
Pin the 'tap a level' hint to the top of the book card.

top_issues: No visible 'Swap' submit button on this frame; the primary action is off-screen on a long scroll, blocking one-handed use.
Jargon stack '1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH', 'Lot rounding', 'Bilateral · signed by both sides' is unreadable for Lucas.
fixes: Add a sticky 'Swap 100 USDC → 0.039992 WETH' CTA bar at the thumb.
Replace bps/lot-rounding with plain 'fee ≈ $0.01' and a one-line 'what is lot rounding?' tooltip.

top_issues: A toast ('Account opening requested with zero credit') overlaps the collateral slider, hiding the control the user must operate.
The 'Gross receive / collateral tariff' paragraph is dense legal-style text with no numbers broken out.
fixes: Render toasts as a non-blocking banner above the keyboard, never over a slider.
Convert the tariff prose into a labelled fee table (base / gas / bps).

top_issues: Cross-network flow shows route and 'Atomic · both legs or neither' but no arrival ETA or total cost on one screen — exactly what Aisha needs on a weak link.
Two 'Prepare to receive' credit panels stack, making the screen feel unfinished.
fixes: Add an 'Arrives in ~Xs · total fee Y USDC' summary row under Route.
Collapse the second prepare panel into a single 'need credit? extend' inline action.

top_issues: 'They owe you, uncovered $115.00 Cover it' packs a value and an action in one violet line; the risk and the remedy are not visually separated.
Bottom explanatory paragraph ('Every frame here is signed…') is the clearest trust text but is the smallest type.
fixes: Show uncovered exposure as a red-amber stat with a separate 'Cover it' button.
Bump the signed-by-both caption to body size.

top_issues: Five action tiles (Pay/Extend credit/Swap/Manage/Dispute) are equal weight; Dispute is a destructive path sitting next to routine ones.
The 5-key legend (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) is small and uses colour + a striped swatch that is hard to map to the bar.
fixes: Separate Dispute into a red-outlined control with spacing from the routine row.
Make the legend interactive: tapping a key highlights its segment in the bar.

top_issues: The irreversible 'Dispute this account…' button is the only CTA but has no confirm step or typed acknowledgement visible, despite 'cannot be undone'.
Sheet covers the live account numbers, so the user disputes without seeing the state being frozen.
fixes: Add a hold-to-confirm or 'type DISPUTE' gate on the red button.
Keep the '+115 / send up to 175' summary pinned above the sheet.

top_issues: Three numbered steps are excellent but the '1 d' window is shown as bold text only; no countdown or deadline timestamp.
No explicit consequence summary (funds frozen, orders withdrawn) as a checklist before the button.
fixes: Render the dispute window as an absolute deadline ('closes 05:24 +1d').
Add a 3-item consequence checklist above the CTA.

top_issues: Header is a 4-way collision: 'Activity', a wrapped 'Today · in $140 out $68.58 · 5 movements', 'Export CSV' and a stray '7 movements' — Priya cannot parse takings at closing.
Filter chips are clipped mid-word ('Accou…') with no scroll affordance.
fixes: Restructure header to one title + one two-line summary + a right-aligned Export button.
Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with a fade edge and full labels.

top_issues: 'Frames: 2 committed entries' is protocol-accurate but meaningless to a lay user and to Elena who wants signatures, not frame counts.
To/Via show truncated hex with no tap-to-copy on each row.
fixes: Add a plain line 'Signed by both you and H1' beside the frame count.
Make every id row copyable on tap.

top_issues: 'Forget vault' (red, destructive) sits directly under 'Reveal recovery phrase' with no separation — a one-handed mis-tap destroys the wallet.
The 'AT THIS SCALE' px table is a developer diagnostic shown as a primary settings block.
fixes: Move Forget vault into a danger section with a confirm dialog and spacing from reveal.
Collapse the scale table under an 'Advanced' disclosure.

top_issues: The three HOME toggles (On-chain/Reserve/Accounts) control visibility, not money, but read like fund-moving switches — risky misreading.
'1 px = $10' scale concept is clever but unexplained until the paragraph below.
fixes: Add 'Show on home' label to the toggle group header.
Put a one-line 'bars are drawn to this scale' caption directly under the SCALE title.

top_issues: 'Sign & send' and 'Add to batch' are equal-size buttons; the batch path is ambiguous and unlabelled for its consequence.
'WHAT HAPPENS' radio 'Fund you through H1' is the only explanation and is grey, easy to skip.
fixes: Demote 'Add to batch' to a secondary text button.
Make the WHAT HAPPENS line a coloured status with an icon.

top_issues: FROM and TO both render three near-identical cards (Wallet/Reserve/Account) with the same balances, so the user must compare two grids to see the move.
Selected state is only a violet border; no check glyph, colour-only selection.
fixes: Collapse to a single 'From → To' stepper showing the delta.
Add a check icon to the selected card.

top_issues: 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' is the single best exposure summary but sits below five tool tiles, so Ingrid scrolls to find it.
Tiles mix concepts (Sovereignty vs Ownership both use a shield icon).
fixes: Promote the money-stands card to the top of the screen.
Give Ownership a distinct icon (people/key).

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' is alarming phrasing for a zero balance and repeats under every token, cluttering the list.
FAUCETS section is cut at the fold with no clear entry.
fixes: Suppress the 'may pull' line when 0.00; show it only when non-zero.
Give FAUCETS a header with an expand control.

top_issues: Three token rows all read '0.00' with identical 'Depository may pull 0.00', so the screen conveys no information to Lucas buying ETH.
'Move into reserve' is a lone arrow tile, ambiguous about direction.
fixes: Hide or grey zero rows behind a 'show empty' toggle.
Label the tile 'On-chain → Reserve'.

top_issues: H1 POOL stats (Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00) give Omar no yield or utilisation signal to judge hub economics.
'Offer to the pool' is disabled with no reason shown.
fixes: Add an APR/utilisation figure to the pool card.
Show a tooltip on the disabled CTA ('enter an amount first').

top_issues: 'Interest you ask · basis points 100 = 1.00% per term' forces the user to do bps math; Omar/Wei want a rate field.
Term options (1 hour/1 day/1 month) are fixed chips with no custom term.
fixes: Provide a percent input that mirrors bps underneath.
Add a 'custom' term field.

top_issues: 'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is the core security fact but is small grey text; Noah needs it prominent.
No visible action to add signers / raise threshold, so the quorum promise is read-only.
fixes: Promote the self-issued line to a labelled status chip.
Add an 'Edit board' CTA (even if gated).

top_issues: 'PER COUNTERPARTY … nothing at risk' is the per-hub verdict Ingrid wants but is one row with no drill-in or amount.
'Save evidence bundle' is the audit action yet styled like a generic button.
fixes: Show the covered/uncovered dollar next to 'nothing at risk' and make the row tappable.
Give the evidence bundle a shield-filled style and a 'what's inside' preview.

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $40' vs 'Promised $115' is the product's best idea but the two are stacked lists; the risk gap (the $115) is not highlighted as the headline.
Long green/violet definition paragraph repeats the home legend, adding length without new info.
fixes: Render enforceable-vs-promised as one split bar with the at-risk amount called out in amber.
Trim the duplicated colour definition to a single line.

overall.verdict: A genuinely thoughtful self-custodial model — the green/violet enforceable-vs-promised rule, dollar-per-pixel scale, per-frame proofs and the dispute explainer are best-in-class for trust and would satisfy analysts and developers. Shipping is held back by one-handed ergonomics (no sticky CTA on Swap/Receive/Move), a cluttered Activity header, colour-only selection states, and a jargon layer (bps, lot rounding, entity id, frames) that blocks casual and older users.
priority_fixes: Add a sticky thumb-reach primary CTA to every long flow (Swap 05/05b, Receive 04, Move 10) so the action is never below the fold.
Rebuild the Activity header (07) into title + one two-line summary + Export, and make filter chips scrollable with full labels.
Strip jargon: plain-English fee (not bps), 'signed by both you and H1' instead of 'frames', and tooltips for lot rounding / entity id (05,08,12).
Enforce non-colour redundancy and a 14px floor on grey microcopy (capacity lines, fees, selection borders) for Rosa (01,02,06,10).
Surface arrival ETA + total fee on cross-network swap (05b) and an 'instantly spendable vs pending' tag on Pay/Receive for Jamal and Aisha.
